          A payment is one payroll run, loan payment, tax payment or other line paid in a single week, or a single Company 1 bill in weeks 2 to 5. Company 2 Customer 163 payments are forecast by category rather than bill by bill, so they are not checked one by one. Invoices more than 60 days overdue are always flagged.
